_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Death Whistle (Quest)#001.src: Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.dst: 안녕하세요! 흠, 갑옷, 무기, 암울한 표정... Wynn 지방에서 오셨군요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#002.src: My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.dst: 전 Voer, 이국 식물 상인이에요. Gavel 마법사들에게 온갖, 어, 완전히 합법적인 물건을 팔죠.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#003.src: Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.dst: 요즘 쇠락 때문에 장사가 영 힘들어요. 여기 자라던 마법 식물들이 죽어 가고 있거든요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#004.src: The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.dst: 마법이 지금만큼 필요한 적이 없는데, 재료가 없으니 늪의 마법사들이 일을 못 해요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#005.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall that from that- er, my book.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.dst: 특히 Death Whistle이 필요해요. 이름만큼 위험하진 않아요- 옛날식 이름일 뿐이죠, 그- 어, 제 책에 따르면요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#006.src: It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.dst: 온갖 신비한 성질이 있는 꽤 희귀한 식물인데, 주변 물건을 움직이게 할 정도예요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#007.src: Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.dst: 여기서 동남쪽 늪에서 가장 높은 산을 찾아보세요. 쇠락이 아직 산꼭대기까진 안 닿았거든요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#008.src: Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.

Death Whistle (Quest)#009.src: Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
Death Whistle (Quest)#009.dst: 산꼭대기에 올라 Black Whistle Leaf {~}개를 얻으세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#010.src: Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
Death Whistle (Quest)#010.dst: [{~4} Death Whistle Leaf]를 가지고 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]의 Voer에게 돌아가세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#011.dst: 너, Voer! 배려 없는 도둑 같으니!
Death Whistle (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#012.src: You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.dst: 네가 무슨 짓을 했는지 모르지? 네 경솔한 행동에 사람이 죽을 거다!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#013.src: Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.dst: 음... 뭐라고요? 엘프 아가씨, 무슨 일이죠? 지금 거래 중인데요?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#014.src: You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.dst: Pink Pelulite를 팔았잖아! 광란을 일으키는 성질을 잊었나? 내 야영지에서 "주운" 약초학 책이라도 읽어 줄까?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#015.src: Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait... wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.dst: 잠깐, 뭐- 뭐라고요? Pink PELULITE!? 전 그 여자분께 행운 부적용 Pink PELUTE를 팔았는데! 어떻게- 잠깐... Pink Pelute가 꽃잎이 더 둥근데... 이런.
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#016.src: You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.dst: 확신도 못 하는군. 이런 부주의는 있어선 안 돼! 제대로 생각하고 조심하지 않으면, 주변 사람들이 고통받는다.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#017.src: I must... make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.dst: 나는... 어려운 선택을 해야겠군. 이 일은 너에게 맡기겠다. 목숨을 남의 손에 맡기긴 괴롭지만, 다른 할 일이 있다. 명심해라, 주민!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#018.src: Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.dst: 아아, 큰일 났다! 인간님, 제발요, Pink Pelulite는 빠르고 강하게 작용해요... 땅의 분홍색 흔적을 따라가세요, 꽃잎이 떨어지거든요. 사고 나기 전에 찾아와요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#019.src: Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#019.dst: 잔여물 흔적을 따라 구매자의 동굴로 가세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#020.src: Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.dst: 아, 음, 나중에 와 주세요! 이상한 일이 벌어지고 있어요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#021.src: My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.dst: 지금 몸이 좀, 음, 제 마음대로 안 돼요! 아무도 다치게 하고 싶지 않아요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#022.src: Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#022.dst: 동굴 속 여자에게서 꽃을 떼어 내세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#023.src: You're back, I see... and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.dst: 돌아오셨네요... 꽃잎도 흘리면서! Pink Pelulite는 되찾았어요?
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#024.src: And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#025.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got in there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.dst: 아, 다행이다! 제때 들어가셨네요. 제 단골이에요- 미인이기도 하고요. 그 Lari 말이 어느 정도는 맞았네요...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#026.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this... but I can't just quit selling the herbs.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.dst: 책을 가져간 건 맞고, 앞으로 이런 일은 더 조심해야겠지만... 약초 장사를 그만둘 순 없어요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#027.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource-rich region here! Especially not any more.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.dst: 먹고살아야 하는데, 이 늪은 자원이 풍부한 곳도 아니잖아요! 이제는 더더욱요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#028.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise... well, I would not think about it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.dst: 그리고 그렇게 그냥 가 버리다니! 인간님이 있어서 다행이지, 아니었으면... 생각하기도 싫네요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#029.src: Regardless, you helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.dst: 아무튼 큰 도움이 됐어요. 재료도 구해 주고 단골 목숨도 구해 줬으니, 선물을 드릴게요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#030.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.dst: 제 상품 견본을 드릴게요. 전부 양조해도 안전하게 미리 손질해 뒀으니, 오늘 같은 사고는 없을 거예요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.speaker: Voer
